chunks: On that day those who disbelieved and disobeyed the Prophet, shall wish they were levelled with the dust, and shall not be able to conceal a thing from God.

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What will disbelievers wish for on the Day of Judgment according to Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nisa underscores the ultimate futility of worldly power when contrasted with divine omniscience, emphasizing that the disbelievers' regret will be too late to alter their fate. The imagery of being pressed into the earth reflects the physical manifestation of their desire to escape accountability, while the clause 'and they will not conceal from Allah any word' confirms that God’s knowledge encompasses both their hidden secrets and their spoken words, leaving no room for evasion.
